policies.title: Samoan ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Samoa as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to a Samoan ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The schedule defines No Visa Required as a visa not required for entry.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Samoan ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Samoan visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to a Samoan ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Samoan ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists Samoa in its No Visa Required cohort.
conditions: Applies to a Samoan ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
